executive.title: Explain the work, not just the next conversation

executive.title: City pages need first-hand local evidence
executive.text: The 24 city hubs currently reuse the same four short topic descriptions. Add real jobs, material choices, attributable reviews and confirmed availability. City history, unsupported weather claims and neighborhood lists cannot substitute for experience.

executive.title: Keep service decisions separate from product specifications
executive.text: Service pages explain assessment, installation, care and the decision to hire. Use short material previews and link to the established Products hierarchy for brands, colors, ratings, accessories and exact specifications.

executive.title: Protect the role of every existing URL

Competitor descriptions are observations of what their pages discuss. Gap labels describe information missing or insufficiently developed in the current service copy. Shared reviews, galleries and forms do not establish service-specific depth or local job provenance. The findings are not a traffic, backlink, conversion or Search Console audit.
